lyrics:
[00:20.550] I think that's what life is about
[00:22.970] Truly findin' yourself
[00:25.480] And then closin' your eyes, and dyin' in your sleep
[00:32.090] I wanna say goodbye
[00:36.380] But I can't find a way to make it out alive
[00:44.820] You know that I've tried
[00:49.120] But I can't find a way to make it out alive
[00:56.690] So goodbye
[01:03.090] So goodbye
[01:09.110] Uh, so goodbye
[01:11.910] It's time to get high again
[01:14.070] At the time, time with you was time well spent
[01:17.130] On my mind, and I can't get you out, I swear
[01:20.470] When you're done, I think 'bout the time we shared
[01:23.430] And I can't help but cry
[01:25.050] I swear I asked God why
[01:26.560] So many goddamn times
[01:28.280] Nothing can help my time
[01:29.870] None of the cars I buy
[01:31.360] I'm tryna fix what's inside
[01:33.170] My regrets haunt me every night
[01:35.560] And now I wanna say goodbye
[01:40.320] But I can't find a way to make it out alive
[01:48.820] You know that I've tried
[01:53.060] But I can't find a way to make it out alive
[02:00.650] So goodbye
[02:07.190] So goodbye
[02:12.760]
title: Goodbye
author: The Kid LAROI
